text:
Sanjay: starting bring-up for CustOrion LoRA into release/1.2.0-serving. scope: validate merge, run nf4-int4 smoke and an experimental int3 probe, and produce a 20-30 example quickpack focused on payments + edge locales. pinging @Lily for the prompt export.
Lily: got it — I exported ORION_prompts_master.csv and will scrub PII. will assemble a 26-example quickpack biased to invoices, currency formats, and timezone/date edge cases. uploading to s3 when ready.
Marco: tiny vocab note after local graft: a token index shifted around percent/currency punctuation which is surfacing as leading-space artifacts on <10-char templates. example diff I saw: ```- token 992: "%" -> 120
+ token 992: "\\u0025" -> 121```
Ivy: customer reported outputs like "%50 off" -> " 50 off" in their smoke tests. we should avoid touching base tokenizer. plan: add token_remap in model manifest + small serving postprocess to canonicalize.
Sanjay: agreed. Lily, include 3 adversarial currency/date examples. keep pack <=26 so CI runs quick.
BenchBot: CI job queued: run/eng-ml/orion-dryrun/3823456789. logs will post here. :robot_face:
BenchBot: started run/eng-ml/orion-dryrun/3823456789 on a100-40gb. config:
```yaml
model: orion-lora-v1
base: small-sage-7b
quant: nf4-int4
kv_cache: enabled
batch: 6
max_tokens: 56
evalpack: orion-quick26.json
```
Marco: int4 first pass (26 examples): EM-fields fp16 0.93 -> int4 0.91, fluency fp16 0.98 -> int4 0.96, P95 latency fp16 200ms -> int4 150ms, cost per token ~ -35%. two cases had cents dropped.
Sanjay: kick int3 but tag experimental and disable kv_cache for int3 runs. capture hallucination count (fabricated amounts) and token-level ppl.
BenchBot: started int3 job (kv_cache: false).
Ivy: pushed a manifest token_remap prototype: {"token_remap": {"121": "120"}} and a tiny unit test for detokenize canonicalization. PR coming.
Lily: uploaded orion-quick26_v2.json to s3://redwood-evals/orion/orion-quick26_v2.json with gold labels for amount/currency/date. link: https://s3.redwood/orion/orion-quick26_v2.json
BenchBot: int3 completed: EM-fields 0.85, fluency 0.90, hallucinations 3/26 (fabricated amounts), P95 110ms. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/orion/3823456789/artifacts.tar.gz
Sanjay: action items: (1) Lily finalize quick26 (done), (2) Marco add serving-side canonicalizer + smoke assertion, (3) Ivy merge manifest remap + unit test, (4) BenchBot attach perf/cost traces to the PR. If int3 regressions unacceptable we'll ship int4 with route-level fallback to fp16 for payment endpoints.
Marco: will add the serving assertion to smoke CI; small postprocess to normalize punctuation after detokenize.
Lily: added one synthetic regression test for amount normalization in tests/evals/amount_norm_orion.py and will gate canary on it.
Sanjay: great — closing thread when PRs are green. :white_check_mark:
